guarantees.claim: prng_en_rand_q is cleared to 0 while rst_ni is low; otherwise, on the rising edge of clk_i it is updated to prng_en_rand_d.

uncertain_points.claim: The origin and timing of prng_en_rand_d are outside this chunk; a glitchy or improperly sequenced source could corrupt the PRNG enable signal.
uncertain_points.cond: any valid clock edge with rst_ni high
uncertain_points.risk: If prng_en_rand_d is not stable or is driven from an unsafe domain, prng_en_rand_q may take an unintended value, potentially enabling/disabling entropy collection at wrong times, weakening security.
